name: Pyramyth - Reborn
review:
Egypt with a neon sci-fi twist, on 15 lines with wild payline multipliers, roaming wilds, sticky respins and a feature buy.

Roaming wilds and sticky respins work together, and payline multipliers boost every line a wild touches. It looks great on a phone. High volatility, 10,000x cap, 96.05% RTP. A fresh take on a very crowded theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
